integrity.computational_role: symbolic and finite-rational consistency checks; not a proof of universal quantifiers

scientific_limitations: Exact for the centered stable two-patch linear Gaussian fluctuation model, not nonlinear population persistence or extinction.
Both local recovery rates and both dispersal directions are equal; the environmental noise covariance is arbitrary positive semidefinite with positive marginal variances.
No empirical parameter calibration; priority comparisons remain provisional where historical appendices were inaccessible.
title: A sharp three-regime law for dispersal and heterogeneous patch volatility
